events.did: ran her hand along the wall of the bedroom Serena had recreated
events.quote_anchor: SYDNEY ran her hand along her bedroom wall.

events.did: rubbed her wrist where her sister’s fingers had dug in
events.quote_anchor: She rubbed her wrist, where her sister’s fingers had dug in.

events.did: pulled the stuffed animal out from among the pillows and saw it was a spotted dog
events.quote_anchor: Sydney drew it out, and saw it was a spotted dog.

events.did: thought of Dol attacking Eli, Dol in need of help, and of Mitch, whether he was hurt or dead
events.quote_anchor: She thought of Dol, attacking Eli. Dol, in need of help. And Mitch. Where was Mitch?

events.did: decided she did not need Serena to drop the illusion, only to move it
events.quote_anchor: Maybe she didn’t need Serena to drop the illusion. Maybe she just needed her to move it.

events.did: abandoned the bedroom and ducked back into the hall, heading for the banister when she heard a sound
events.quote_anchor: With sudden resolve, Sydney abandoned the bedroom and ducked back into the hall. She was just heading for the banister when she heard the sound.

events.did: collapsed, and the dream fell apart with her, dropping Sydney back into the real shack in the abandoned park
events.quote_anchor: Serena collapsed, and as she did, so did the dream, the house in Brighton Commons dropping like a curtain

events.did: ducked the EO’s shot, a dart burying itself in the wall above her head, and then ran
events.quote_anchor: his weapon swinging with it, and Sydney ducked a breath before the gun went off, a dart burying itself in the wall above her head.

relations.did: built the dream of Sydney’s old bedroom so exactly that it looked unchanged
relations.quote_anchor: Credit to her sister, the room looked exactly as it had, down to the patterned duvet, the book on the bedside table

relations.did: brought Sydney the purple scarf in the hospital, now wrapped around the stuffed dog’s neck
relations.quote_anchor: the one Serena had brought her in the hospital, wrapped around its neck.

relations.did: shot Serena, a red dart jutting from her neck
relations.quote_anchor: Saw Serena sway, a red dart jutting from her neck.

relations.did: let Sydney get only as close as possible to having her own pet
relations.quote_anchor: The closest her parents had let her get to having her own pet.

numbers.did: a month — the lyrics she had scribbled on the mirror were still there a month after Serena left
numbers.quote_anchor: even the lyrics she’d scribbled on the mirror, a month after her sister left.

numbers.who: The darkened shack in the abandoned park
numbers.did: a second floor — little more than a platform, on which Sydney was standing
numbers.quote_anchor: The layout was different, but there was a second floor, little more than a platform, and she was standing on it, exposed

numbers.did: a ten-foot drop — she stood inches from the edge of the platform
numbers.quote_anchor: she was standing on it, exposed, inches from the edge, a ten-foot drop.
